title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): New values (AsReadOnly & AsReadWrite) for the AllowInCustomizations property
summary: BC27 introduces new values (AsReadOnly, AsReadWrite) for the AllowInCustomizations property to give AL developers finer control over how table fields can be used in page customizations. This property can now be set at table, table extension, and field levels, with corresponding analyzer rules to support field classification.
key_points: BC27 adds AsReadOnly and AsReadWrite to the AllowInCustomizations property. Never still keeps fields out of page customizations.
With AsReadOnly, a field can be added in a page customization but not made editable. Setting Editable to true gives error AL0808.
ToBeClassified (the default) and the deprecated Always both behave like AsReadOnly. Using Always produces warning AL0667.
The property can now be set on tables and table extensions. On an extension it only covers fields declared in that extension.
The new analyzer rules AS0138, AS0139 and PTE0026 are optional and do not block AppSource or PTE uploads.

quotes.text: AsReadOnly - allows use in page customizations, but only as read-only. AsReadWrite - allows fields to be made editable in page customizations.
quotes.why_it_matters: These new values provide explicit control over field editability in customizations, replacing the ambiguous Always value

quotes.text: For efficiency, AllowInCustomizations can now also be set at the table and table extension level.
quotes.why_it_matters: Setting the property at higher levels simplifies field management when the same rule applies to multiple fields
